strings.Många butiker, kaféer och restauranger a: Many shops, cafés and restaurants hire without advertising. Walking in, introducing yourself and leaving your CV often works better than an email, especially for your first job.
strings.Lägg till var du bor i din profil, så vi: Add where you live in your profile to see places near you.

strings.Säg vem du är, när du kan jobba och att: Say who you are, when you can work and that you learn fast. Twenty seconds is enough.
strings.Lämna ett utskrivet CV med ditt telefonn: Leave a printed CV with your phone number at the top.
strings.Hör av dig igen efter några dagar. De fl: Follow up after a few days. Most people don’t, so it gets noticed.
strings.Vill du se genomgången igen, eller svara: Want to see the walkthrough again, or answer the questions once more?
strings.Nej, inte för att använda det. Att svepa: No, not to use it. Swiping, getting jobs that suit you, template letters, Walk in and your saved jobs are always free. You also get about five AI-written applications a month at no cost.
strings.Var kommer jobben ifrån?: Where do the jobs come from?
strings.Från Arbetsförmedlingens Platsbanken och: From the Swedish Public Employment Service’s Platsbanken and from other Swedish job sites they collect, such as studentjob.se and ledigajobb.se. The list is updated every Monday and Thursday, and ads that have been removed disappear then.
strings.Hur väljer ni vilka jobb jag ser?: How do you choose which jobs I see?
strings.Vi går igenom varje annons och sorterar: We go through every ad and, when Youth mode is on, filter out jobs that require training, a licence, a driving licence or several years of experience. Then we show the jobs closest to you first. When the AI help is on, it also reads your profile and gives each job a match percentage.
strings.Sorteringen bygger på annonsens text och: The filtering is based on the ad’s text and can sometimes be wrong. Always read the ad before you apply.
strings.Varför ser jag inga jobb nära mig?: Why don’t I see any jobs near me?
strings.Kontrollera att du har skrivit var du bo: Check that you’ve entered where you live under Profile and that the max distance isn’t too small. Some areas simply have few ads right now. Then try Walk in, where you’ll see places near you that may hire without advertising.
strings.Ingenting skickas utan att du trycker på: Nothing is sent unless you press it. When the employer takes applications by email, your own email app opens with the letter filled in, and you attach your CV and press send. Otherwise we open the employer’s application page and you paste the letter there.
strings.Hittar AI:n på saker om mig?: Does the AI make things up about me?
strings.Den är instruerad att bara använda det s: It’s instructed to only use what’s in your CV and profile. It can still make mistakes, so always read the letter and change what you want before you send it.
strings.Du får jobba från 16 år, men det finns r: You can work from 16, but there are rules on how late and how much you may work and which tasks you may do. A parent or guardian often needs to approve the job. Read more on
strings.Arbetsmiljöverkets webbplats: the Swedish Work Environment Authority’s website
strings.Gå till Profil och tryck på Hantera abon: Go to Profile and press Manage plan. You can cancel right away there. You keep what you’ve paid for until the end of the period. A week pass never renews automatically.
strings.Hur använder jag mitt konto på en annan: How do I use my account on another device?
strings.Under Profil, Ditt abonnemang, finns din: Under Profile, Your plan, you’ll find your account code. Copy it and paste it on the other device. Don’t share the code with anyone else.
strings.Det här sparas i din webbläsare: What is stored in your browser
strings.Din profil, ditt CV, dina ansökningar oc: Your profile, your CV, your applications and which jobs you’ve swiped are stored in this browser on your device. We can’t see them. You can delete everything with the button at the bottom.
strings.Det här sparas på vår server: What is stored on our server
strings.En slumpad kontokod, vilket paket du har: A random account code, which plan you have, how much AI you’ve used and when your period ends. If you’ve paid, we also store the customer ID that our payment provider Stripe gives us. The server is in Stockholm. We don’t store your letters or your CV on the server.
strings.När du använder AI-hjälpen: When you use the AI help
strings.För att skriva brev, pitchar eller match: To write letters and pitches or match jobs, the text needed (for example your profile, your CV and the ad) is sent through our server to Anthropic in the USA, which produces the text. Anthropic doesn’t use the data to train its AI models and handles it under its terms for business customers.
strings.Betalningar hanteras av Stripe. Vi ser a: Payments are handled by Stripe. We never see your card number.
strings.Trycker du på en kartlänk öppnas Google: If you tap a map link, Google Maps opens with the workplace’s address. Links to ads open the employer’s or job site’s own page.
strings.Vi använder inga reklam- eller spårnings: We don’t use advertising or tracking cookies and we never sell your data.
strings.Du har rätt att få veta vilka uppgifter: You have the right to know what data we hold about you and to have it corrected or deleted. Contact us and we’ll help. You can also complain to the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY).
strings.Jobbsvep hjälper dig att hitta lediga jo: Jobbsvep helps you find open jobs and write applications. We don’t promise that you’ll get a job, and we’re not responsible for the content of employers’ ads.
strings.Brev och pitchar skrivs av AI. Du ansvar: Letters and pitches are written by AI. You’re responsible for what you send, so always read the text first.
strings.Du har 14 dagars ångerrätt. Om du ber os: You have a 14-day right of withdrawal. If you ask us to start right away and use the AI help during that time, you pay for what you’ve used. Contact us to cancel a purchase.
strings.Det är inte tillåtet att försöka komma r: You may not try to get around the limits, create many accounts or use the service in an automated way.
strings.Tar bort din profil, ditt CV, dina ansök: Removes your profile, CV, applications and account code from this device. If you have a plan, cancel it first under Profile.

Week costs 49 kr and lasts 7 days. 3 months costs 299 kr and lasts 90 days. Neither renews. Month costs 129 kr and renews every month until you cancel under Profile, Manage plan. Prices include VAT. The AI help in a plan applies during the plan’s period and doesn’t carry over to the next one.

Swiping, matching, template letters, Walk in and about 5 AI applications a month are always included. If you want more AI-written applications, there’s Week for 49 kr, Month for 129 kr and 3 months for 299 kr. You can choose any time.
